title: Analyse your own spending
desc: Load a year of transactions, group by month and category, and chart where the money goes.

title: City weather history
desc: Download ten years of daily temperatures and check whether summers where you live are getting warmer.

title: SQL on CSV files with DuckDB
desc: Query a large CSV directly with SQL, no database server needed. Compare the speed with pandas.

title: Public dataset dashboard
desc: Pick an open dataset from your city or country and build three charts that answer one clear question.

title: Board game collection stats
desc: Export your collection and plays, then find your most-played games, cost per play, and what is gathering dust.

title: Your step count, charted
desc: Export the step data from your phone and find your most and least active weekdays and months.

title: Baby names over time
desc: Chart how the popularity of your own name has risen and fallen over a century.

title: Reading log dashboard
desc: Record the books you finish and chart pages per month, genres and ratings.

title: Test Benford's law
desc: Count the first digits in a real data set, such as town populations, and compare with the prediction.

title: Film ratings explorer
desc: Find which genres and decades rate best, and how the answer changes with the number of votes.

title: Map your walks
desc: Load the GPS tracks from your phone or watch and draw every walk on one map.

title: Listening history
desc: Request your listening history and chart your top artists by year and by hour of the day.

title: Home energy use
desc: Chart your electricity use against outdoor temperature and look for what drives it.

title: Live earthquake map
desc: Plot the last week of earthquakes from the public USGS feed, sized by magnitude.

title: A week on a postcard
desc: Pick one thing to count for a week, such as doors or thank-yous, and draw it by hand, Dear Data style.

title: Wikipedia attention
desc: Chart daily page views for a topic and match the spikes to what was in the news.

title: Family survey
desc: Write a short, light-hearted survey for family or friends and present the results as charts.

title: League table simulator
desc: Simulate the rest of a sports season thousands of times and estimate each team's chances.

title: Redraw a famous chart
desc: Recreate Nightingale's diagram or Minard's map in code. You learn the tool and the design at once.

title: Bird sightings near you
desc: Download local bird records and chart which species turn up in which months.
